latestVersion.changelog:
**Initial release of ai-humanizer-backup: a comprehensive tool to detect and remove AI-writing patterns and humanize text.**

- Identifies 24 common AI writing patterns across content, language, style, communication, and filler categories.
- Flags and replaces over 500 suspicious AI vocabulary terms, grouped by tier.
- Uses statistical analysis (burstiness, type-token ratio, sentence length variation, trigram repetition) to assess text naturalness.
- Provides actionable suggestions and auto-fixes to rewrite AI-sounding content while preserving meaning and tone.
- Offers multiple command-line reports: scoring, analysis, suggestions, stats, and one-step humanization.
- Supports "Always-on mode" for agents to consistently write like a human without prompts.
